picks.headline: Goodfellas' Vincent Maraval Says Michel Hazanavicius Cut Eight Days of Production on 'The Third Hand' by Using AI
picks.excerpt: At San Sebastian's Creative Investors' Conference, Goodfellas CEO Vincent Maraval said AI turned a ten-day shoot for a major WWI scene in Hazanavicius' 'The Third Hand' into two days, arguing AI can expand filmmakers' creativity.
picks.rationale: A concrete, attributed production number from an Oscar-winning director's film: a ten-day WWI scene shot in two days. It gives producers a real budget-and-schedule benchmark.

picks.headline: Seedance 2.5 Just Got a Load of Awesome New Features!
picks.excerpt: Dreamina's Seedance 2.5 canvas overhaul adds an AI agent that plans and organizes a shoot, an Elements library that carries characters and voices across prompts, new Skills, and MiniMax H3, GPT Image 2 and Nano Banana Pro inside the canvas.
picks.rationale: A shipped update to one of the most-used video models. The Elements library keeps characters and voices consistent across prompts, which fixes the continuity problem creators run into every day.

picks.headline: Duncan Jones on Why It's 'Harder Than Ever' to Make His Kind of Movies (and Why He Refused to Use AI for His Newest One)
picks.excerpt: The 'Moon' director explains how his decade-long animated 'Rogue Trooper' adaptation got made and why he refused to use generative AI as a shortcut in its animation pipeline.
picks.rationale: The opposite call to the Hazanavicius pick: a working director explains why he kept generative AI out of an animation pipeline where it would have been the cheaper option.

picks.headline: CaptionX Clips for Turning Long Videos Into Shorts
picks.excerpt: AI captioning maker CaptionX launched Clips, which analyzes a long video or podcast and returns ranked, self-contained short moments ready to publish.
picks.rationale: A new post tool that editors can try today. It automates cutting long footage down to ranked short clips, which is the social-deliverables work every post house now owes.

picks.headline: Camera Angles Are Becoming a Thing of the Past
picks.excerpt: Curious Refuge tests three AI methods for generating new camera angles from existing shots, with a written breakdown and prompts.
picks.rationale: A hands-on test of three ways to make coverage in post, with the prompts included. It shows how far one good take can stretch before a reshoot is needed.
